findings.text: _queued_review_run_fields now asks _review_in_flight for the single standing review, and that reader has no phase filter: a launched review standing for the same head is returned, obligations.py:771 then returns None, and a queued review that also stands for the head is reported as review-missing. The sweep this replaced filtered on QUEUED_PHASE first and ordered candidates by queued_at, so the earliest queued review was always the one named; that tie-break is gone and the choice now follows list_live order. Two reviews for one head are needed to reach it, so it is latent rather than live.

_live_pointers ignores its project argument whenever a view region is open, so a reader inside a view that asks for another project is silently served the view's snapshot; the region is also private to this module, so the per-pointer loop at reckon/crew/obligation_snapshot.py:954 calls _current_review_in_flight outside any region and still reads the whole live directory once per pointer, which is the repeated read this change removes only on the obligations() path.
